spongebert.name: SpongeBert
spongebert.bio: An endlessly cheerful fry cook who lives in a pineapple and loves his job more than anything in the ocean.
spongebert.catchphrase: I'm ready! I'm ready! I'm ready!

pat.name: Pat Starfish
pat.bio: SpongeBert's best friend. Lives under a rock. Thinks very hard about things, occasionally.

squidwerd.name: Squidwerd
squidwerd.bio: A grumpy cashier and self-declared artistic genius who just wants some peace and quiet for his clarinet.

mr_crabs.name: Mr. Crabs
mr_crabs.bio: Owner of the Krusty Crab. A retired sea captain whose one true love is money. Argh!

sandy.name: Sandy Acorn
sandy.bio: A karate-chopping scientist squirrel from Texas who lives under the sea in an air-filled dome.

arnald.name: Arnald
arnald.bio: A kind, optimistic fourth-grader with a football-shaped head who lives with his grandparents at a boarding house. Always tries to help.

helga.name: Helga Potaki
helga.bio: The toughest kid in the fourth grade, with one eyebrow and a big pink bow. Secretly writes love poems about Arnald.

gerold.name: Gerold
gerold.bio: Arnald's cool, level-headed best friend. Keeper of the neighborhood's urban legends. Tall hair, taller confidence.

grandpa.name: Grandpa Phil
grandpa.bio: Arnald's grandpa. Runs the Sunset Arms boarding house, tells tall tales from the old days, and calls Arnald "Shortman".

phoebee.name: Phoebee
phoebee.bio: Helga's brilliant, loyal best friend. Top of the class, fluent in facts, and always ready with a plan.

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.bio: A fancy voice from somewhere above the waves.
